A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have proposed a new control scheme to improve switching frequency stabilization for on-time controlled converters, which can reduce the effort required for electronic-magnetic interface design.

we have developed a new method to reduce the switching frequency variation in the on-time control buck converter by employing a sensorless load current correction technique and a dynamic tolerance window technique.

we have successfully demonstrated that a simple adaptive on-time controlled buck converter with an adaptive voltage positioning mechanism can be used to achieve high power efficiency, low noise, and excellent load regulation performance.

a simple and effective method for switching frequency stabilization is presented for on-time-controlled buck converters.
a simple and effective switching frequency stabilization mechanism can be implemented using only the output voltage sensing circuit and a simple logic gate.
